3778530 - [CVE-2026-76964] Memory Corruption Vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP (Internet Communication Manager)
SAP Security Note, Version: 7, Released On: 2026.11.10
Component: BC-CST-IC   Priority: HotNews   CVSS v3.0 Base Score: 10.0

Symptom
SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP does not sufficiently validate certain network input processed by an internal component. An unauthenticated attacker could send specially crafted network traffic to trigger a memory corruption condition in the affected functionality.

Reason and Prerequisites
Improper validation of size/length parameters in WebSocket control frames during reassembly resulted in a heap-based out-of-bounds write.
SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java is not affected.

Solution
The correction is delivered with the kernel patch level listed in "Support Packages & Patches". All higher patch levels also contain the correction.

Workaround
- If the affected ICM is accessed exclusively through an SAP Web Dispatcher, a Web Dispatcher updated to the patch levels in FAQ Note 3778788 can be used as a temporary workaround.
- Otherwise, WebSocket support can be disabled as a workaround (not recommended: significant impact on interactive and integration scenarios).
